results.title: Session settings
results.checks: The host starts a session and a guest joins. Session settings shows the session's link, Navigation and Sharing, and the participants with a Host badge. By default the guest's › moves the host too; with 'Only host can navigate' ticked the guest's › moves only the guest. A verse the host taps flares on the guest's screen. The host's End Session ends it for the guest
results.note: link, settings and participants shown; the guest moved the host by default and not after Only host can navigate; the host's tap flared on the guest's screen; End Session ended it

results.title: The old reader's display choices
results.checks: Settings → Display & Theme: text size XXL, line height Loose (2.5), interface Extra large (125%); Book order Tanakh puts Isaiah right after 2 Kings in the book picker; Show discovered content off takes the Discover card away; Verse selection effects offers Default, Enabled, Disabled
results.note: XXL, Loose and Extra large applied; Tanakh order put Isaiah after 2 Kings; the Discover card hid and came back; the effects choice is there

results.title: The phone's Theme & text sheet
results.checks: On an iPhone 13 the sliders in the chapter's top bar open the old reader's Theme & text sheet: the larger A makes the verses larger and the smaller A smaller; the line-spacing button cycles the spacing; UI size L, then M; Keep screen awake toggles; Go to all settings opens the Settings list in the drawer
results.note: text m → l → m; spacing normal → relaxed and back; UI size L then M; keep awake toggled; Go to all settings opened Settings

results.title: The book picker is laid out as the old reader's
results.checks: At 1495 px: one row of the translation (BSB ▾), the search box and All books; Old Testament in three columns filled down each column (Genesis, Exodus… then 2 Chronicles), New Testament in two; the book on screen open with its chapters as a full-width row of square buttons and the current chapter filled; Song Of Solomon by its full name. At 390 px: a header of ×, Books and the tabs, one column, and the current chapter in view
results.note: desktop: one header row, OT 3 columns, NT 2, full-width chapter row, chapter 3 filled; phone: × Books ☰, current chapter in view

results.title: Settings in the sidebar
results.checks: The ⚙ at the bottom left of the sidebar turns the sidebar into Settings, in place of the tabs — Account settings, Display & Theme, Toolbar, Extensions, Install App, Launch tutorial, Customize, About Seed Bible, then Language; Display & Theme opens its page there, a line-height choice there changes the chapter, ← goes back to the list; ✕ brings the tabs back
results.note: ⚙ → Settings: Account settings · Display & Theme · Toolbar · Extensions · Install App · Launch tutorial · Customize · About Seed Bible; Display & Theme's line height reached the chapter; ← back to the list; ✕ brought the tabs back
